segments.sn35.150:1.3: katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā?
segments.sn35.150:3.1: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?

segments.sn35.150:9.3: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?

segments.sn35.150:13.1: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn35.150:15.1: “Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati … pe …
segments.sn35.150:15.2: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.150:15.5: Ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā”ti.

lines: Paṭipāṭiyā pana catūsupi etesu suttesu saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā.
Nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā desitāti katvā “saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā”ti vuttaṃ.
